English.text: So, hi, I'm Vikram, working as a hardware engineer. I work on setting up hardware devices, connecting sensors, testing Raspberry Pi systems, and troubleshooting hardware issues. I also help us to integrate the devices with the software platforms and ensures everything runs smoothly during testing.

German.text: Also, hallo, ich bin Vikram, ich arbeite als Hardwareingenieur.
